title: Normalized finite coefficient tensors commute with derived pullback
statement: Let A be a finite discrete commutative topological ring, R a commutative condensed ring, e:R ≅ coefficient(A) an isomorphism of ring objects, and E_T a normalized Encoding A T on each scheme T, as in [def-sfb-finite-coefficient-operation-encoding]. Write F_T for the constructed coefficientEncoding. For every scheme morphism p:X → Y there are natural isomorphisms alpha:F_Y ⋙ Lp*_ordinary ≅ Lp*_internal ⋙ F_X and m_T:F_T(K tensor_internal L) ≅ F_T(K) tensor_ordinary F_T(L) for T=X,Y. For the published pullback tensor comparisons phi and phi0 these satisfy CategoryTheory.Adjunction.ComparisonCompatible alpha phi phi0 m_X m_Y: F_X(phi(a,b)) followed by m_X equals alpha inverse at a tensor b, then Lp*_ordinary(m_Y), then phi0, then the tensor of alpha at a and b. Only derived pullbacks and tensor bifunctors occur; no projection morphism or direct-image invertibility is asserted. The data are bundled in TensorPullbackCompatibility, with tensor bifunctors inferred from the native pullback comparisons; the theorem asserts Nonempty of this data. The native projection contexts bundle the published adjunctions and pullback tensor comparisons without changing them; their projection is definitionally the published canonical projection.

proof.text: Construct the actual heart encoding N_T=Res(e inverse)_T followed by the given ordinary and fixed encoding equivalences. Its factors are additive equivalences, so it is exact and an equivalence. The explicitly constructed identity-on-sections direct-image square determines the heart pullback comparison by conjugation and uniqueness of left adjoints. Apply [lem-sfb-finite-coefficient-heart-tensor-square] to obtain compatible strong monoidal structures on N_X,N_Y and monoidality of this fixed heart comparison. This is the sole remaining concrete normalization step, with no derived construction included.

Exact monoidal equivalences preserve flat objects. Apply the proved generic composition/naturality identity Functor.map_leftDerivedTensorComparison_comp_eq_of_iso to the four heart functors. It gives ComparisonCompatible for their actual total left derived functors and tensor comparisons. The identities in [new-proetale-derived-module-pullback-monoidal] identify the internal published comparison with this generic one; the ordinary comparison has the generic definition.

For T=X,Y compose the exact-functor isomorphism L(N_T) ≅ D(N_T) with mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Its target is definitionally the original coefficientEncoding functor. Transport the two tensor isomorphisms and the pullback square across these isomorphisms. Naturality of the isomorphisms and of the tensor comparison proves ComparisonCompatible after transport; the private comparisonCompatible_transport lemma contains this calculation. Bundle the transported data in TensorPullbackCompatibility. No native context, public statement, or tensor is changed.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientTensorPullbackEncoding
    (e : Mon.mk R ≅ Mon.mk (coefficient A))
    (E : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, Encoding A T)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y) :
    Nonempty (Adjunction.TensorPullbackCompatibility
      (coefficientEncoding A e Y (E Y)) (coefficientEncoding A e X (E X))
      (internalProjectionContext R p).comparison
      (ordinaryProjectionContext (ULift.{u + 1} A) p).comparison)
